svg.text: PetWell V2 ER diagram (from schema.prisma) · Blue = v1 tables · Green = new in V2 (D17, D23–D27)

Enums: Role = OWNER / CLINIC_STAFF · RecordType = VACCINE / TREATMENT · ClinicType = GENERAL / EXOTIC / EMERGENCY_24HR · AccessType = APPOINTMENT / OWNER_SHARE · GrantEndReason = REVOKED / CANCELLED / REJECTED
AppointmentStatus = PENDING / CONFIRMED / REJECTED / RESCHEDULED / COMPLETED / CANCELLED · FK → table without a line: relation shown by the FK label
? = nullable · 1 / M / 0..1 = cardinality · Active grant = ended_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now)
